payload.reason: The re-ranking approach described in the paper is a transductive learning technique because it utilizes a test set that is available after deployment, indicating that it learns from the specific instances of data it encounters post-training.

claims.text: The re-ranking approach learns a similarity function using features from the query and answers, which aligns with transductive learning principles.
The method improves the performance of deployed QA systems by using feedback from a test set, characteristic of transductive learning.
